nodes.description: Address of the contract owner in Ownable; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Pausable boolean flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers; set true in buy() once minCap is reached.
Hard-coded wallet address that receives all ETH raised by the sale.
CCCRCoin token contract used to send reward tokens to buyers/owner.
Base token price used by getRate(); writable only by the owner via updatePrice.
Scaling constant (1e10) used to convert wei into token units.
Sale start timestamp used together with block.timestamp for bonus tiers.
Minimum amount of tokens raised before the sale pauses itself.
Cumulative tokens distributed; increased after the external ETH transfer in buy().
Safe multiplication with assertion against overflow.
Integer division helper.
Safe subtraction asserting b <= a.
Safe addition asserting no overflow.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; gates privileged functions.
Owner-only function that changes the owner address.
Owner-only function that sets paused = true.
Owner-only function that sets paused = false.
Constructor that stores the reward token address.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.sender/msg.value to buy().
Internal constant rate function that branches on block.timestamp bonus periods.
Payable purchase function: computes tokens, transfers tokens, forwards ETH, updates totalRaised and pauses on cap.
Owner-only setter for tokenPrice.
Owner-only function moving reward tokens from this contract to the owner.
Owner-only batch airdrop looping over address/amount arrays.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization and as buyer.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving the bonus rate branches in getRate().
External CCCRCoin.transfer call inside buy() whose return value is not checked and which occurs before state finalisation.
External ETH transfer of this.balance to investWallet performed before totalRaised is updated.
External token transfer from the sale contract to owner in transferTokens().
External token transfer executed per loop iteration inside airdrop().
Privileged owner assignment from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier.
State write pausing the sale when totalRaised reaches minCap.
buyer address parameter of buy(); becomes the token transfer receiver.
_amount parameter of buy(), the wei amount used for token computation.
Local variable amount = _amount / zeroAmount in buy().
Local variable tokens = amount * getRate() in buy().
Constructor parameter with the reward token contract address.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership().
New token price parameter of updatePrice().
Token amount parameter of transferTokens().
Address array parameter of airdrop().
Amount array parameter of airdrop().
Memory copy of the address array in airdrop().
Memory copy of the amount array in airdrop().
Loop bound computed as arrayAddress.length.sub(1).
Loop counter incremented with SafeMath.add.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the buyer argument when the fallback calls buy().
Fallback function forwards execution to buy().
buyer parameter is used as the receiver of the token transfer.
_amount is divided by zeroAmount to produce the local amount.
zeroAmount is the divisor used to scale the incoming wei amount.
amount is multiplied by the rate to compute tokens.
getRate() return value feeds the tokens computation.
tokenPrice is the base value multiplied in getRate().
Bonus tier selection depends on block.timestamp, making the rate miner-influenceable.
SafeMath.mul is used inside getRate() to apply bonus multipliers.
SafeMath.div is used inside getRate() to normalise by 100.
tokenReward is the contract on which the external transfer is invoked.
Computed tokens are the amount sent in the external token transfer.
_amount.div(zeroAmount) uses SafeMath.div for the scaling.
amount.mul(getRate()) uses SafeMath.mul for the token calculation.
investWallet is the destination of the ETH transfer of the whole contract balance.
totalRaised is updated only after the external ETH transfer, allowing re-entrant drain.
buy() performs the external ETH transfer before finalising its own state.
A malicious reward token can re-enter buy() from its transfer callback before totalRaised is updated.
Reaching minCap on totalRaised triggers the paused = true write.
minCap is the threshold compared against totalRaised to pause the sale.
The pause write sets the paused state variable to true.
totalRaised.add(tokens) uses SafeMath.add to accumulate raised tokens.
whenNotPaused modifier gates buy() on the paused flag.
whenNotPaused modifier gates the payable fallback on the paused flag.
pause() requires the contract not to be paused already.
unpause() requires the contract to be paused.
msg.sender is stored directly as owner in the Ownable constructor.
The Ownable constructor performs the owner assignment.
msg.sender is the left-hand side of the onlyOwner authorization comparison.
owner is the right-hand side of the onlyOwner authorization comparison.
Only the owner (per the require check) may call updatePrice().
Only the owner may call transferTokens().
Only the owner may call airdrop().
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts pause to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts unpause to the owner.
newOwner parameter is the value assigned to the ownership slot.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
The CCCRSale constructor assigns the reward token state variable.
_tokenReward constructor parameter is stored in tokenReward.
_tokenPrice parameter is written into the tokenPrice state variable.
updatePrice() mutates tokenPrice.
tokenReward is the contract invoked by the external transfer in transferTokens().
_tokens parameter is the amount transferred out to the owner.
owner is the recipient of the tokens in transferTokens().
transferTokens() performs the external token transfer.
tokenReward is the contract invoked per iteration in airdrop().
_array1 is copied into the memory address array.
_array2 is copied into the memory amount array.
arrayLength derives from arrayAddress.length.
arrayLength is computed with SafeMath.sub(1).
arrayAddress[i] supplies the recipient address for each transfer.
arrayAmount[i] supplies the amount for each transfer.
Loop counter i indexes both arrays in the transfer call.
arrayLength bounds the while loop that performs the transfers.
Loop condition compares i against arrayLength.
i is incremented with SafeMath.add(1).
airdrop() executes the external token transfer inside its loop.
buy() executes the external token transfer to the buyer.
buy() conditionally executes the pause write when the cap is reached.

normalization_plan.reason: buyer is a parameter that only exists to feed CCCRSale.buy; merge it into the buy function node.
_amount is a parameter of buy() and has no independent semantic role; merge into buy.
Local amount is a temporary inside buy() and should be folded into buy.
Local tokens is produced solely to feed the external token transfer call, so merge it into that unsafe operation.
_tokenReward constructor parameter is consumed only by the CCCRSale constructor; merge it into that function node.
newOwner is a parameter used only by transferOwnership; merge into that function node.
_tokenPrice is a parameter used only by updatePrice; merge into that function node.
_tokens is the amount consumed directly by the external transfer in transferTokens; merge into that unsafe operation.
_array1 is a parameter consumed only by airdrop; merge into the airdrop function node.
_array2 is a parameter consumed only by airdrop; merge into the airdrop function node.
Local arrayAddress only provides addresses to the looped external transfer; merge into that unsafe operation.
Local arrayAmount only provides amounts to the looped external transfer; merge into that unsafe operation.
arrayLength is a loop bound local inside airdrop; merge into the airdrop function node.
Loop counter i is purely a local control variable of airdrop; merge into the airdrop function node.
